description.short_caption: Vesicular and crusted lesions on the lower lip and perioral skin.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the lower face, focusing on the lips and surrounding skin. There are grouped vesicular lesions with overlying crusting on the lower lip and extending slightly to the adjacent perioral skin. The lesions appear localized and are consistent with a vesiculobullous process, possibly of infectious etiology. The surrounding skin appears otherwise unremarkable.
visible_findings: localized involvement of the perioral skin
